units: <cite ref="Ketubot 3a:4">Keth. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>שויוה רבנן לבְעִילָתוֹ בְּעִילַת זנות</he> the Rabbis (in this case) have declared his coition (by which he wanted to establish marriage), a mere act of prostitution (annulled his marriage).

<cite ref="Ketubot 73a:1">Ib. 73ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>אין אדם עושה בעילתו בעילת זנות</he> the presumption is that nobody wants to make his intercourse with a woman one of prostitution (but wants to make her his wife thereby).—
<cite ref="Ketubot 4a:1">Ib. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>בעילת מצוה</he> the marital duty, i.e. first coition; frequ. <he>ב׳ ראשונה</he>. Y. Macc. II, 31ᵈ; a. fr.—Pl. <he>בְּעִילוֹת</he>.
